The Atari, Sega and SNK official histories independently verify the other answer labels as real video-game companies and their specific history notes; none is identified as publisher of Space Invaders in the full exact-game context. literalGroups.literal: Space Invaders — аркадная игра Taito, выпущенная в Японии в 1978 году. Её успех вызвал сначала в Японии, а затем и по всему миру бум аркадных игр.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Strong states at L202 that Space Invaders was Taito’s arcade video game and released in Japan in 1978. L203 describes the success and worldwide arcade craze, supporting the second sentence.

literalGroups.literal: Atari основали Нолан Бушнелл и Тед Дэбни в 1972 году.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Atari’s official history names co-founders Nolan Bushnell and Ted Dabney and says they founded Atari in 1972. This is a concrete, option-specific fact.

literalGroups.literal: Соник стал «лицом» Sega и дебютировал в игре 1991 года.
literalGroups.primaryGround: SEGA’s official Sonic history says the project created a character to become SEGA’s face, identifies Sonic, and dates the first game to 1991.
literalGroups.locator: SEGA Sonic 20th Anniversary History L27-L31 and L38-L40.

literalGroups.literal: В 1990 году SNK представила аркадную MVS и домашнюю Neo Geo.
literalGroups.primaryGround: SNK’s official history dates the MVS arcade system and home NEO-GEO launch to 1990 and describes both platforms.

literalGroups.literal: В публикации The Strong 2021 года Space Invaders названа самым популярным тайтлом Taito.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Strong’s 2021 article says that decades after release Space Invaders remained Taito’s most popular title. The note attributes this time-bounded source statement to the publication instead of presenting it as a live ranking.
literalGroups.locator: The Strong L206 and publication date L219.
